capabilities: Define cards from H2 headings in scanned Markdown files
Organize cards into decks with hierarchical #flashcards tags
Select cards randomly or by least-recently-viewed with view tracking
Browse and cycle cards in a modal with deck switching
Embed static or self-refreshing card blocks in notes
disambiguation: Not a spaced-repetition study tool; it rotates cards for activities, prompts, and strategies, with no review scheduling.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; a JavaScript API is exposed at window.deckNotes.api.
problem: Obsidian can pick a random note, but there is no way to define curated decks of small content cards and rotate through them evenly from notes or commands.
summary: Card deck plugin that turns H2 headings into cards, selected randomly or least-recently-viewed, browsed in a modal or embedded live in notes.
